# Acme Documents (acceptance fixture)

TEST ONLY. Use the `mcp` command to search Acme documents:

- `mcp servers` — list this task's servers (acmedocs).
- `mcp tools acmedocs` — list the tools.
- `mcp describe acmedocs search` — inspect the search tool.
- `mcp call acmedocs search '{"query":"..."}'` — run a search. The server
  may ask a short form question on the way; answer it when Locus shows it.
